summary_1line: Sita recounts her exile to the disguised Ravana, who reveals himself and tries to seduce her, but she fiercely rejects and insults him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana disguised as a mendicant stands before Sita in the forest hermitage as she politely recounts her story of exile.
Ravana reveals his identity with pride while Sita stands before him in the forest, glaring with fearless contempt.
Sita, trembling like a leaf yet defiant, points in anger while rebuking Ravana with comparisons of a jackal challenging a lion.
